verdict.rationale: Cloudflare AI Gateway explicitly supports policy-driven model switching via Dynamic Routing (visual/JSON config for segment-based routing, budget/rate limits, A/B rollouts) and Fallbacks (automatic switch to another model/provider on error or timeout, with cf-aig-step header indicating which model handled the request). These directly satisfy switching by cost, capability, or availability without app code changes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of this working in production agent workflows, and explicit documentation of capability-based (not just error/availability-based) routing logic.
